events.description: Organization registered.
User provisioned from first OIDC login or seed.
First authenticated request of a session (Audit LOGIN).
Organization membership roles or status changed (Audit ADMIN_ROLE_CHANGED).
Project created.
Project archived.
Member added (P0 direct add; also triggers invitation notification).
Member removed. Governance revokes that user's grants scoped to the project.
Member project role changed.
Dataset created.
Access level changed (Audit POLICY_CHANGED).
allowed_purposes / approval_required / max_grant_days changed (Audit POLICY_CHANGED).
Version published and now immutable. Readiness auto-queues default profile.
Access request submitted or resubmitted.
Reviewer started review (SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW, D-025).
Request approved; grant created ACTIVE.
Request rejected.
Reviewer asked requester to change the request.
Requester withdrew the request.
Grant revoked by steward, org admin, or system (project member removed / project archived / membership disabled).
Emitted once per grant 72h before expires_at.
Sweeper marked grant EXPIRED. Enforcement does not depend on this event.
Signed download URLs issued (Audit FILE_DOWNLOADED).
Download session denied (security monitoring).
Validation run moved to RUNNING.
Validation run finished (run_status COMPLETED or FAILED).
Self-service profile fields changed (e.g. NTIS researcher number).
Non-policy dataset metadata or contributors changed (Audit DATASET_UPDATED; M11 index input).
Dataset version pinned as a project input (Audit PROJECT_INPUT_ADDED; notes evidence INPUT_ADDED; hub most_used).
Pinned input version changed explicitly (Audit PROJECT_INPUT_VERSION_CHANGED; notes evidence INPUT_VERSION_CHANGED).
Project input removed (Audit PROJECT_INPUT_REMOVED).
Recipe created or saved as a new version (Audit RECIPE_SAVED; notes evidence RECIPE_SAVED).
Recipe run finished and produced a DERIVED_DATASET output (Audit RUN_SUCCEEDED; notes evidence RUN_SUCCEEDED).
Recipe run failed; error is a short summary without data values (Audit RUN_FAILED; notifies the run starter; notes evidence RUN_FAILED).
Output created from a run or an upload (Audit OUTPUT_CREATED; notes evidence OUTPUT_CREATED).
Hub publication of an output requested; one approval slot per organization (Audit OUTPUT_PUBLISH_REQUESTED; notifies the organizations' DATA_STEWARDs; notes evidence PUBLISH_REQUESTED).

One organization decided a publish request; request_status is the request status after this decision (Audit OUTPUT_PUBLISH_DECIDED; notifies the requester). A terminal catalog publication failure is reported as a system REJECT (request_status REJECTED) with failure_reason.

Comment added (first comment of a new thread included). project_id is null for DATASET threads and required (non-null) for PROJECT/OUTPUT/RECIPE threads (Audit COMMENT_ADDED; DATASET threads notify the owner organization's DATA_STEWARDs).
Research note submitted and locked (Audit NOTE_SUBMITTED; notifies witnesses).
A signature was recorded; final=true when the note became SIGNED (Audit NOTE_SIGNED; notifies the recorder when a witness signs).
Witness returned a submitted note to DRAFT with a reason (Audit NOTE_REJECTED; notifies the recorder).
Someone other than the recorder opened the note (Audit NOTE_VIEWED, 열람 관리대장).
